message.reasoning:
I need to make a decision on a Monopoly auction for NORTH_CAROLINA_AVENUE.

I will bid $32. The $31 high bid is too low to secure the property. I need to block p4 from completing a PA+NC pair. My cash buffer is tight, so I cannot afford to chase higher bids.

If p4 bids higher, I will drop out. They cannot complete a green monopoly without Pacific Avenue, which is mortgaged by p1.

Mortgaging NORTH_CAROLINA_AVENUE immediately after winning would net $118 in cash. I need to verify whether mortgaging is allowed outside my turn.

The action state only permits bidding. Mortgaging will likely be an available action after the auction.

Owning NORTH_CAROLINA_AVENUE at $32 or below still has positive expected value because the $150 mortgage value provides a cash safety net.

No houses are in the bank, so the property cannot be improved yet.

p4 has $763 in cash. A two-property hold is a stepping stone toward a full green set.

I am currently on p4's mortgaged Pennsylvania Avenue, so I do not pay rent here.

From this position, rolling 3 lands on Park Place for $1100, rolling 5 lands on Boardwalk for $1700, and rolling 12 lands on Oriental for $400.

Spending $32 on NORTH_CAROLINA_AVENUE leaves me with $694. That is still enough to cover the $400 Oriental rent.

Fully liquidating all holdings yields roughly $1596. Boardwalk at $1700 remains fatal even after selling every house and mortgaging every unmortgaged property.

The auction is currently on p1's turn. I will bid $32 to secure NORTH_CAROLINA_AVENUE. The mortgage arbitrage is the key: if I win for under $150, mortgaging the property immediately would increase my cash and ease the Pennsylvania Avenue crisis.

The turn order is now clear: p1 resolves the auction, then it becomes my turn. I will roll next. Whether I can mortgage NORTH_CAROLINA_AVENUE before that roll is uncertain, since many implementations require rolling immediately after an auction. Even without immediate mortgaging, a $32 bid is excellent value for a $300 property with a $150 mortgage value.

Blocking p4 from completing the green set also prevents them from trading Pacific Avenue for a stronger position. Pacific remains the only missing piece to finish the greens.
